tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask Ben 1 to 4 multiple-choice questions and wait for the answers. Use it at a real fork only Ben can settle: an ambiguous requirement, a choice between approaches with different tradeoffs, a preference, a go-ahead. Not for what you can find out by reading or running things, and not to ask permission for routine steps. The questions show as a card in the thread and in Needs you, where Ben can always type an answer of their own, so never offer "Other". Your turn waits on this call until Ben answers or skips, which can take hours. If they send a message instead, it tells you to read that message.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask Ben 1 to 4 multiple-choice questions and wait for the answers. Use it at a real fork only Ben can settle: an ambiguous requirement, a choice between approaches with different tradeoffs, a preference, a go-ahead. Not for what you can find out by reading or running things, and not to ask permission for routine steps. The questions show as a card in the thread and in Needs you, where Ben can always type an answer of their own, so never offer "Other". The call waits up to 45 seconds. If Ben has not answered by then, it says so and you end your turn: the answer arrives as your next message.
